name: @kingggg5/shipproof
description: Secure-by-design engineering skills and evidence gates for Codex and Claude Code.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run pack:check && npm run test:package
scripts.lint: npm run lint:node && npm run lint:python
scripts.lint:node: node --check bin/shipproof.mjs && node --check lib/cli.mjs && node --check lib/evidence.mjs && node --check lib/mcp-server.mjs && node --check lib/package-info.mjs && node --check lib/policy.mjs && node --check lib/safe-path.mjs && node --check scripts/release-info.mjs && node --check scripts/run-action.mjs && node --check scripts/package-smoke.mjs && node --check tests/node/cli.test.mjs && node --check tests/node/platform.test.mjs && node --check tests/node/policy.test.mjs && node --check tests/node/golden-parity.test.mjs && node --check tests/node/k6-determinism.test.mjs && node --check tests/node/e2e.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:python
scripts.test:node: node tests/node/cli.test.mjs && node tests/node/platform.test.mjs && node tests/node/policy.test.mjs && node tests/node/golden-parity.test.mjs && node tests/node/k6-determinism.test.mjs && node tests/node/e2e.test.mjs
scripts.test:python: python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_*.py -v && python -m unittest discover -s examples/demo-api/fixtures/after/tests -v
scripts.test:python:coverage: python -m coverage erase && python -m coverage run -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_*.py && python -m coverage run --append -m unittest discover -s examples/demo-api/fixtures/after/tests && python -m coverage report && python -m coverage xml

author: Jesadakorn Pipitakun
